corpus_limitations: These are educational reference texts. Their historical examples and accounting conventions are not evidence of current reporting, tax or legal requirements.
A book section may cite a numeric example or a formula stored only in an image. Image-dependent material must be identified before writing the test questions.
Author biographies, acknowledgements, navigation and donation banners are excluded. The selected instructional content must still be reviewed for incidental personal information before submission.
The corpus explains financial concepts; it contains no live financial statements for a user's company.
